nodes.label: Open-World AI Game Engine
nodes.rationale: Browser<->Next.js<->Upstash Redis<->FastAPI AI server + Upstash Search RAG; data-driven world, Dijkstra pathfinding, fuzzy biome transitions.

nodes.label: World Biome and Entity Systems
nodes.rationale: Block grid (x,y,depth, weight, durability, physics, traps), 5 biomes, player/mobs/NPCs/hallucinations, 15 item categories, rune socketing, 11 skill categories.

nodes.label: RAG Memory and Scenario Slots
nodes.rationale: Story drain every 25 actions to game-memory index scoped by sid; scenario save slots with export/restore/autosave; SSE push delivery.
